extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels, large backdrops and rows for Trakt continue watching, trending titles, your library and your liked Trakt lists (via Seren).
Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen, grote achtergronden en rijen voor Trakt verder kijken, trending titels, je bibliotheek en je Trakt-lijsten (via Seren).
extension.news: 1.30.36: TV guide: the name and number of the channel that is playing stay visible. 1.30.35: Sport and TV only start (tabs added, background helper) when Kodi has TV channels, so the skin stays fast for people without IPTV. 1.30.34: TV guide: the red vertical line is gone; the channel stops when you leave the guide (unless you went full screen). 1.30.33: TV guide: the channel number and name no longer disappear on the channel you are on. 1.30.32: TV guide: a red bar at the bottom of the programme that is on now, growing with the time; the progress bar and the LIVE label at the top now work. 1.30.31: TV guide: the channel you are on plays live in the window at the top right (after a moment on it; stops when you leave the guide, unless you went full screen); the guide jumps to the current time. 1.30.30: TV guide: the red block is gone (now a thin red line for the current time); the groups slide away when you go to the channels and the guide uses the full width; the playing channel shows live in the top right. 1.30.29: TV guide: the timeline with channels was empty because the window did not register it as its view; fixed. 1.30.28: Sport: national teams show a plain flag instead of the round badge with little bars (standings, cards, game pages, follow lists). 1.30.27: TV tab: a real TV guide - groups on the left, channels with logo and number, a timeline with the programmes, and a header with the focused programme (poster, time left, description) and a preview of the channel that is playing. Back goes to the groups. 1.30.26: Add-ons item shows the video, program and music add-ons as landscape rows. 1.30.25: Add-ons item shows your Favourites as a landscape row (replaces the add-on rows from 1.30.22). 1.30.24: Add-ons item: the add-on rows are now also added to an existing Add-ons item that looked different; many more row choices under + Add a widget > Favourites and add-ons (installed add-ons, updates, pictures, music, TV channels). 1.30.23: selection lists (language, etc.): Right/Left now scroll a page at a time. 1.30.22: Home: the Add-ons item now shows rows of your video, program and music add-ons (existing menus get these rows once; you can change them in the menu editor). 1.30.21: film player: the Stop button now sits left of Play; Previous and Next only show for series; the subtitle search (magnifier) button says A4KSubtitles under it when selected. 1.30.20: Sport > All games: you can go Up again from the channels to Remind me / Record and to the TV window (the No channel text no longer sits inside the list), and the three buttons (Remind me, Record, Stop channel) fit. 1.30.19: Sport > Formula 1 game page: on the right the circuit of the race weekend instead of the programme: name and place, the drawing of the track, length / laps / turns / direction and the lap record (from ESPN). 1.30.18: Sport: the games of a country you follow (for example the Dutch team in the Nations League) now show up even when they are more than two weeks away: Lucent asks ESPN for the dates of those games and fetches exactly those days (once per 12 hours). 1.30.17: Sport: the Updating pill at the top left is tidier: a small rounded pill with a red dot and a thin progress line inside it. 1.30.16: Sport > All games: the text No channels found no longer sits on top of the Follow buttons in the right panel. 1.30.15: Sport: competitions show their own logo (Eredivisie, Premier League, ...) in front of the name on Follow (cards and the row on top) and on Tables; the logos are asked from ESPN once and remembered. 1.30.14: live TV: the score box of the game on your channel now shows at once (from what Lucent already has) and updates a moment later with fresh numbers, instead of after about 5 seconds. 1.30.13: Sport: you can go to the TV window with the remote (Right from the big card or the channels, Up from the buttons) and press OK to make the channel full screen; on My sport, All games and the game page. 1.30.12: Sport > My sport: the channel buttons in the TV window are gone (OK on a game opens the game page with the channels); cards of a followed country get its colour (Netherlands orange). 1.30.11: Sport: Back in the full screen player of a channel you started from Sport makes it small again in the TV window (and brings the Sport page back); the channel closes when you leave Sport. Other videos: Back still stops. 1.30.10: Sport > My sport: every game card keeps its competition logo, now clearer; Formula 1 cards are red all over. 1.30.9: Sport > My sport: the selected game card shows its competition logo (F1, Eredivisie, ...) large and faint in the grey. 1.30.8: Sport: OK on the channel that is already playing now goes full screen from the game page too (the page closes first, because a pop-up cannot switch screens) and tries several ways when Kodi does not react. 1.30.7: Sport: Back goes up one step at a time: from the games to the tab (for example All games), then to My sport, then out of Sport. 1.30.6: Sport: OK on a channel that is already playing (also when you started it somewhere else, like the TV tab) now goes full screen instead of starting it again. 1.30.5: Sport > Tables: the club colour now covers the whole screen (a strip at the right stayed black). 1.30.4: Sport > Tables: the club you select shows as a large, faint logo on the right and tints the background with its colour. 1.30.3: Sport: the background takes the colours of the two clubs on All games and on the game page too, like on My sport. 1.30.2: Sport: a channel in the TV window keeps playing when you leave the page or go to another one, until you press Stop channel (new button) or Stop; OK again on the playing channel goes full screen on every sport page. 1.30.1: Sport: the Choose channel button is gone (the channels are listed below anyway); a channel now starts inside the TV window instead of full screen (Lucent sets the PVR switch to full screen setting to Never for a few seconds while it starts). 1.30.0: Sport: the live TV window is always there, top right, like the reference: on All games (above the game info) and on the game page (above latest goals and the table); OK on a channel plays it in the window, OK again full screen, Back stops it. 1.29.0: Sport: a channel now starts in the small TV window behind the page (no full screen flash) when Kodi gives its address, else as before. My sport: the whole grey panel is the TV window with the channels as buttons along the bottom. All games and team pages: the TV window opens over the game info when you choose a channel. 1.28.0: Sport > My sport: next to the big card is now a small live TV window. OK on a channel starts it there, OK again goes full screen; Back stops it. 1.27.3: Sport: the big card shows the two club colours side by side without overlap; when the TV guide names no channel for a game, the sport channels of your IPTV list (Dutch / Belgian first) are shown as Maybe so you can still press OK and watch. 1.27.2: Sport game page: round pills for SHOWING IT and the quality (FHD/4K), a rounded logo tile on each channel row, balbezit as a whole percentage, and room for four channels. 1.27.1: Sport: back to one request per day (the per-year request was not reliable for the current season); when ESPN does not answer for some days the Sport page now says how many days and why (for example HTTP 429), so we can see what goes wrong. 1.27.0: Sport > Follow: every sport has its own icon (basketball, baseball, tennis, golf, racing, rugby, hockey, american football, fighting) in the sports list and on the competition cards. 1.26.3: Sport: football games are now fetched with one request per year instead of one per day (about 15 times fewer requests), so ESPN no longer blocks us and the games come back; falls back to per day when a year answer is empty or cut off. 1.26.2: Sport > Follow: the club you are on now has a clear white and red frame (also on red clubs) and a lighter card, so you see where you are. 1.26.1: Sport: when ESPN is busy, days that fail are asked again and the games we already had are kept, so football games no longer disappear from Live sport and the big card. 1.26.0: Sport game page scoreboard like the reference: wide header with both teams and a big score, a LIVE panel with the minute or HT and a progress bar, channel rows with logo, SHOWING IT and quality pills; the table and latest goals sit lower on the right. 1.25.1: Sport game page: the club pop-up now opens on top of the game page, so the page no longer disappears and comes back when you close it. 1.25.0: Sport game page redone like the reference: big score at the right of each team, LIVE pill with minute bar, your channels with logo, team statistics (possession, shots, on goal, corners), top performers, latest goals and the table; parts stay empty when ESPN has no data. 1.24.6: Sport game page: the score and LIVE with the minute (or HT) show in the middle for a game that is on or finished; the two clubs at the top can be selected (Up from the channels) and OK opens the club pop-up. 1.24.5: Sport: only the place you are on has a red mark; the other rows no longer keep a red outline (lists you left only keep a quiet grey mark). 1.24.4: Sport: game rows and cards show the logo of the channel (from your IPTV list) instead of its name; the name stays when a channel has no logo. 1.24.3: Sport game page: Left from Full table now goes back to the buttons (also when there are no channels), and the buttons row fits (a followed team shows a check mark and its name). 1.24.2: Sport and TV: the place you are on is now red on every page (buttons, days, followed teams, lists, game page, pop-ups). 1.24.1: Sport: the name stays readable on the selected day and on followed teams (dark text on the white button); game page, club pop-up and team card now really take focus, so you can move and press OK; Tables: sport buttons keep their place and the form squares fall back to games we already hold. 1.24.0: Sport > game page: a click on a club opens a pop-up with its game now, last result and next game (with channel) and the buttons Watch now, Follow, All their games and Team info. 1.23.1: Sport tables: the last five results (coloured squares) are fetched in one request per year, so they no longer go missing when ESPN is busy. 1.23.0: live TV player redone: a compact info bar (channel, LIVE, quality, score, programme, progress, what is next) and with OK the same bar with pause, a settings button and a row of recent channels (first the TV guide); the settings button opens channel up/down, subtitles, audio, record and more. Shows the live score when the channel shows a game you follow. 1.22.1: Sport > Tables: choose the sport on top (Football, Basketball, ...) and below it only the competitions of that sport, so the list is short and tidy. 1.22.0: new player menu for live TV: TV guide, channel down/up, pause, record, subtitles, audio, info and stop; the channel with number, the programme with start/end time, a progress bar and what is next. Films and series keep their own menu. 1.21.1: Sport: tidier loading (one calm panel with a progress bar the first time, a small bar while updating or reading the guide), and the big card on My sport only shows games of teams you follow. 1.21.0: new TV tab: your IPTV channels with groups, what is on now (with progress) and next, search, OK to watch. Sport finds the TV guide better: checks again, retries an empty guide after 5 minutes and shows the reason when no guide is found. 1.20.0: Sport: OK on a game opens a full game page. Team games show both teams with record, place and form, the start time with a countdown, your channels, Remind / Record / Follow / Fix channel, match info and the league table with both teams highlighted. Races and events get their own layout with the schedule of the weekend. 1.19.0: Sport > Follow is now a page: sports on the left (with the number you follow), competitions on top, and the teams as colour cards; OK follows or stops following. The strip on top shows everything you follow; Search, Order and More open the old tools. 1.18.0: Sport > All games looks like the reference: rows with league, team logos, names and records, channel and arrow, a heading with the number of games, red outline on the selected game. 1.17.5: Sport > My sport: the big card only shows games of the teams you follow. 1.17.4: Sport: fixes HTTP 400 from ESPN (it no longer accepts a date range, so games are fetched day by day). 1.17.3: Sport: asks ESPN like a normal browser and retries when busy; the error message shows the HTTP code. 1.17.2: Sport: shows Loading while games are fetched and a message when ESPN cannot be reached. 1.17.1: Sport > My sport: every team, competition or name you follow now has its own row, also without games or without IPTV. 1.17.0: Sport > My sport has a new start screen: a big card of your next game in both team colours (Left/Right flips), your channels next to it, and a row of game cards per team or competition with scores, times and channel. The background takes the colours of the game you select. OK on a game opens a menu (watch, remind, record, fix channel, follow, table). 1.16.1: Sport: tables that were saved by an older version showed empty (Eredivisie, Eerste Divisie, Belgium); fixed, and the list of tables opens faster. 1.16.0: Sport: almost 200 competitions from ESPN (football worldwide, NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, rugby, F1, IndyCar, NASCAR, golf, tennis, UFC and more); Follow > Choose competitions picks the sport first. 1.15.0: Sport tables: last five results as coloured squares, place changes (up/down arrows), coloured edges for Champions League, Europa League and relegation, team colours, your teams outlined in gold, and a team card (OK on a team) with record, home and away form, last three results, next game, Watch now, Remind me, Follow and all games. 1.14.0: Sport: Fix channel (remembered per game, competition or team), reminders (5 minutes before), automatic switching (1 minute before, 10 seconds to cancel), recording for 1 to 6 hours, optional automatic reminders for your teams. 1.13.1: Sport: follow countries (Follow > Choose countries, or search), with friendlies, Nations League, European Championship and World Cup, shown with Dutch country names. 1.13.0: Sport > My sport: big card with your next games in the team colours (Left/Right flip), Live & upcoming, then a block per team, competition or name in your own order with your place in the league. Search to follow a team, country or competition; following a club includes its cups and European games. 1.12.1: in choice lists with check marks (like Follow teams) the check is visible on the highlighted row, and Right jumps straight to OK. 1.12.0: new Sport tab: all games of your competitions with times, scores and tables, and the IPTV channels (from your IPTV Simple Client guide) that show each game. Follow competitions, teams or a name. 1.11.4: the update pop-up now really installs the new version (downloads it itself and reloads the skin). 1.11.3: Profiles screen: the two top rows now have their text, profiles get a person icon. 1.11.2: Skin settings buttons open the right category (Seren > Accounts for Trakt, Seren > Playback, Kodi language settings) instead of the first one. 1.11.1: optional automatic subtitle search (A4KSubtitles) when a film or episode starts without subtitles in your language. 1.11.0: A4KSubtitles support: Search subtitles button in the player menu, settings and a Use as default button in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.10.0: pop-up when a new version of Lucent is available (Update now / Later / Skip this version), switch and Check now in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.9.10: add-on info page uses the full width in a glass panel, Automatic update switch no longer cut off. 1.9.9: colour swatch in subtitle settings (Colour, Border colour) sits on the right of the row. 1.9.8: System info screen tidier (each line in its own row, CPU/RAM/temperature as pills). 1.9.7: Calendar info text scrolls by itself when long, watched check stays red on the focused row, System info first tab says Summary. 1.9.6: wider Calendar, week cards no longer clipped, series logos in the week view, Up wraps around in Add-ons and library lists. 1.9.5: watched check marks are red, calendar buttons and week view tidied. 1.9.4: Calendar opens a series straight on its seasons in Seren (no search), week view spacing. 1.9.3: list view: the duration no longer disappears behind the watched check mark. 1.9.2: the Calendar now shows the series and films of your Trakt collection; the bell (off by default) gives a pop-up for a new episode or a digital film release. 1.9.1: nicer on-screen keyboard, Enter on a real keyboard now finishes typing, the Settings home screen wraps around. 1.9.0: new Calendar tab (Week, List, Month) for the series and films you follow with the bell on the info page, with a pop-up when a new episode is out (Watch now / Later; switch in Skin settings > Tracking). 1.8.5: Home rows and skin settings wrap around too. 1.8.4: Back stops the video, lists wrap around, Right goes to OK in add-on settings, trailers stop when you move on. 1.8.3: trailer video no longer hidden behind the Home background on CoreELEC. 1.8.2: trailers close the YouTube error pop-up and pause after repeated failures. 1.8.1: sidebar now says Lucent. 1.8.0: Lucent is now its own add-on (skin.lucent). On first start it takes over all settings, menu and widgets of Nuvio Arc.

extension.summary: Pop-up bij een nieuwe versie van het Seren-thema Lucent
Pop-up when a new version of the Lucent Seren theme is released
extension.description: Kijkt op GitHub of er een nieuwe versie van het Seren-thema Lucent is. Is dat zo, dan krijg je een pop-up met wat er nieuw of veranderd is, en kun je meteen bijwerken. Na een update zie je één keer wat er nieuw is.
Checks GitHub for a new version of the Lucent Seren theme and shows a pop-up with the release notes, with the option to update right away.
extension.news: 1.1.0: nieuwe naam Lucent; herkent het thema onder de naam Lucent en de oude naam; testknop in de instellingen.
